summary: Configured persistent internal time synchronization with chrony. node1 (10.100.4.10) serves NTP to the cluster; node2 uses node1 exclusively. Both nodes remained healthy and synchronized after sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled chrony on both nodes.
Configured node1 as an upstream-synchronized NTP server for 10.100.4.0/24 with a local fallback clock.
Configured node2 with only 10.100.4.10 as its time source.
Verified active synchronization, UDP/123 service, client requests, and persistent configuration.
Rebooted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: node1 is the persistent internal time source
evidence.summary: Post-restart configuration allows 10.100.4.0/24, chrony is active/enabled, UDP/123 is listening, upstream synchronization is normal, and node2 client requests are recorded.
Post-restart configuration contains only server 10.100.4.10; it is selected, node2 is stratum 4, and the system clock reports synchronized.

Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f to 2a3d6dcf-44bd-44b9-809d-0bf53701beb7, recovered service/listener, and renewed node2 synchronization and client traffic.

Captures healthy synchronized baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb to 3714e1c2-6371-42be-bc14-34d42d6567c6, and recovered active/enabled service with node1 re-selected.
